tips.start: The blocks under this one run when the procedure runs. Blocks lying loose on the canvas are kept as drafts.
tips.run_on_client: Sends a packet so the blocks inside run on that player's client.
tips.run_on_server: Sends a packet so the blocks inside run on the server.
tips.wait: Runs the blocks inside later, on the server.
tips.cancel_event: Cancels the event that ran this procedure, when the event can be cancelled.
tips.log: Writes a line to the game log on the side where it runs.
tips.java_code: Runs Java as it is, on the Minecraft version it was written for; other versions skip it and the build warns. Dependencies are parameters by name; list the ones it reads.
tips.particle_spawn: Client-only. In a server procedure the generator sends it to the players in a packet.
tips.particle_burst: Client-only. In a server procedure the generator sends it to the players in a packet.
tips.sound_play_local: Client-only. Only this client hears it.
tips.gui_open: GUI elements are generated in a later version; no engine generates this block yet.

tips.entity_data_get_number: Reads or writes an entity data entry of one of this mod's living entities; other entities give the default value.
tips.entity_data_set_number: Reads or writes an entity data entry of one of this mod's living entities; other entities give the default value.
tips.entity_data_get_logic: Reads or writes an entity data entry of one of this mod's living entities; other entities give the default value.
tips.entity_data_set_logic: Reads or writes an entity data entry of one of this mod's living entities; other entities give the default value.
tips.entity_data_get_text: Reads or writes an entity data entry of one of this mod's living entities; other entities give the default value.
tips.entity_data_set_text: Reads or writes an entity data entry of one of this mod's living entities; other entities give the default value.
tips.in_dimension: Runs the blocks inside in the level of another dimension: every block in there that uses the world uses that level. Does nothing when the level does not exist or this runs on a client.
tips.block_data_number: A number a procedure kept at a block with block_set_data (-1 where there is no block entity, 0 where the key was never set). Blocks with an inventory keep it; from 1.21.5 only those blocks do.
tips.block_set_data_number: Keeps a value at a block position, in its block entity, and sends it to the clients watching it. Does nothing on a client or where the block has no block entity.
tips.block_slot_item: A copy of the item in a slot of the block's inventory; empty when the block has none.
tips.block_set_slot_item: Replaces the item in a slot of the block's inventory.
tips.command_arg_number: The number typed for a command argument. Only in a mod command's program or a procedure it calls.
tips.text_decimal_format: Java DecimalFormat: "##" rounds half to even to a whole number, other characters in the pattern are written as they are ("##R" gives 12R).
tips.text_translate: The translation of a key in the language of the side this runs on; the key itself when that side has no translation. A dedicated server may not have the mod's language files: to show a translated message to a player use the translated message block of the Players category, which lets the player's game translate it. In a procedure that runs on the server the translation is in the server's language for every player, so do not store it in a variable, block data or other value the clients read (the editor warns); store the key and translate where it is shown.
tips.player_message_translated: Sends a message that the player's own game translates: the key and the arguments go to the client, which looks the key up in its language files, so a dedicated server without the mod's language files still shows translated text. Arguments are the entries of the list (text, numbers or logic values) in order; they fill the argument places of the translation text.
tips.block_place_keeping: Replaces the block at a position with another one. Properties both blocks have are copied and the block entity's data (inventory, block data) moves to the new block.
tips.item_random_in_tag: One item of the tag picked at random as a stack of 1; air when the tag has no items.
tips.gui_slot_item: The item in a slot of the GUI the player has open (GUIs made by MCEdge number their slots as set in the GUI element); empty when none.
tips.gui_set_slot_item: Replaces the item in a slot of the GUI the player has open and sends the change to the player.
tips.entity_has_permission: True for a player whose command permission level is at least the given one (1 moderator, 2 game master, 3 admin, 4 owner); false for other entities.
tips.item_rarity_is: Whether the item's rarity is the chosen one (the colour of its name).
tips.block_break_dropping: Drops what the block's loot table gives where it stands, then removes it without dropping a second time.
tips.compare_item_types: True when both stacks hold the same kind of item, whatever their count or data; two empty stacks are the same (air).
tips.entity_look_block: A ray from the entity's eyes along its view ends at a block; this is that block's x, y or z. The ray ignores fluids.
tips.world_nearest_entity_in_box: Among the players, server players or item entities inside the box, the one nearest to the point; no entity when there is none.
tips.sound_play_in: On the server everyone near hears it; on a client it plays locally. The category sets which volume slider it follows.
tips.block_energy: The energy a block's storage holds or can hold. On Fabric it reaches blocks of this mod only, as Fabric API has no energy.
tips.block_energy_receive: Pushes energy into the block's storage, within its input limit.
tips.block_energy_extract: Takes energy out of the block's storage, within its output limit.
tips.block_fluid: The millibuckets a block's tank holds or can hold.
tips.block_fluid_id: The fluid in a block's tank, or empty text when it holds none.
tips.block_fluid_fill: Puts fluid into the block's tank, as far as it fits and the tank accepts that fluid.
tips.block_fluid_drain: Takes fluid out of the block's tank.
tips.effect_add_ticks: Adds an effect for a number of game ticks (20 per second) without checking the side. Amplifier 0 is level I.
tips.world_spawn_item: Spawns an item entity. Never despawning keeps it in the world until picked up.
tips.entity_is_monster: True for hostile mobs (the Monster class).
tips.item_is_tool: 1.16.5 tests the item's class; later versions have no tool classes and test the vanilla tool tags (modded tools count when they are tagged).
tips.block_set_property: Sets a whole-number block state property such as power, only when the block has it and allows the value.
tips.block_set_property_logic: Sets a true/false block state property such as powered, only when the block has it.
tips.item_hurt_break: Damages the stack like a tool use (unbreaking applies). When that breaks it, one item is taken and the rest is repaired. 1.16.5 only: 1.21.2 replaced the call and it is not generated there yet.
tips.gui_remove_slot_item: Takes items out of a slot of the GUI the player has open and sends the change to the player.
tips.text_from_double: 5 becomes 5.0 and 0.1 stays 0.1, exactly as Java joins a decimal number to text.
tips.effect_ticks_left: How many ticks the effect still lasts on the entity; 0 when it does not have it.
tips.command_arg_entity: The entity typed for a command argument; no entity when none was given. Only in a mod command's program or a procedure it calls.
tips.world_total_day_time: Ticks since the world began, not wrapped to one day like time of day.
tips.return_void: Ends the procedure here. Only for procedures that return nothing.
tips.text_from_itemstack: 1.16.5 writes a stack as its count, a space and the item's registry name ("3 coin"); later versions write it differently, so this block keeps that text on every version.
tips.text_substring_java: Exactly Java's substring: both positions must be whole numbers inside the text, otherwise the procedure fails with an error.
tips.world_set_game_rule_number: Runs the gamerule command for a whole-number rule of this mod, from the server, with full permission. Does nothing on a client.
tips.world_can_see_sky_from_water: Like sky visible, but water above does not block the view.
tips.world_raining_flag: The raining switch of the world's weather, which turns on at once; "is raining" follows the fading rain level. On a 26.x client there is no switch and the rain level is used.
tips.entity_is_animal: True for animals (the Animal class: cows, sheep, pigs, wolves).
tips.gui_open_at: Opens the GUI as if from the block at that position, so its slots use that block's inventory.
tips.gui_open_session: Opens a GUI whose slot inventory is 'Shared session' for the player on the session with this id; players who open the same id see and edit the same slots live, with no block. The session ends when the last one closes it: each item left goes back to the player who last added to its slot (or, when that player is offline, to the one closing it). Nothing opens for an empty id or a GUI without sessions.
tips.gui_session_id: The id of the session the GUI the player has open shows; empty when it shows none. Use it in the GUI's procedures and slot lock conditions where block GUIs use x, y, z. The GUI's open procedure runs on its first tick, so it can read it; on a client it is known from then on.
tips.gui_close_session: Closes the session's GUI for every player who has it open, which ends the session (items go back as when the last player closes it).
tips.gui_image_restart: Starts the animation of a GUI image whose animation start is 'On procedure call' again from its first frame, on this client (a server procedure sends it to the player). Image: the image component's name, or its number in the GUI; empty restarts every such image of the GUI. Until the first restart the image shows its first frame.
tips.session_viewer_count: How many players have the session open; 0 on a client or when no one has it open.
tips.session_slot_item: A copy of the item in a slot of the session; on a client only the session of the open GUI.
tips.session_set_slot_item: Puts the item into a slot of the session on the server. The item has no owner: left there when the session ends, it goes to the player closing it. Does nothing on a client or when no one has the session open.
tips.session_data_number: A value kept with the session, like block data without a block (0 when the key was never set, -1 when no one has the session open). On a client the values of the open GUI's session, sent by the server.
tips.session_set_data_number: Keeps a value with the session on the server and sends it to the players who have it open. Does nothing on a client or when no one has the session open (open it first); the values end with the session.
tips.session_data_logic: A value kept with the session, like block data without a block (false when the key was never set, false when no one has the session open). On a client the values of the open GUI's session, sent by the server.
tips.session_set_data_logic: Keeps a value with the session on the server and sends it to the players who have it open. Does nothing on a client or when no one has the session open (open it first); the values end with the session.
tips.session_data_text: A value kept with the session, like block data without a block (empty when the key was never set, empty when no one has the session open). On a client the values of the open GUI's session, sent by the server.
tips.session_set_data_text: Keeps a value with the session on the server and sends it to the players who have it open. Does nothing on a client or when no one has the session open (open it first); the values end with the session.
tips.client_item_activation: Plays the totem-of-undying animation with the item on the player's screen. Only does anything on a client.
tips.player_clear_matching: Removes up to that many items equal to the stack's item from the player's inventory, including the crafting grid and the item held on the cursor.
tips.player_has_stack: True when any slot of the player's inventory (armor and offhand too) holds the same kind of item.
tips.entity_count_item: Adds up the counts of the stack's kind of item in the entity's inventory. On later versions only players hold items to count.
tips.block_use: Right-clicks the block with an empty hand as the player, aimed at nothing in particular: opens its GUI or runs its use effect.
tips.for_each_player: Runs the blocks inside once for each player: in this dimension, the players in this procedure's world; on the server, every online player in any dimension (none when this runs on a client). Blocks that take the player (messages, items, its position, teleport) act on it in its own dimension; blocks that use the world at a position, such as block data, still use this procedure's world and x, y, z.
tips.player_by_name: The online player with this name (case does not matter), in any dimension; no entity when nobody by that name is online.
tips.block_material_is: The block's 1.16.5 material. Materials were removed from the game in 1.20, so later versions test the blocks a pickaxe mines, the nearest set to stone.
tips.bubble_show: Shows a bubble element (Bubble in New element: its background, icon, caption and animation are designed there) above the player's head, to every player in the same dimension. Empty: the default bubble. The caption fills the bubble's {text}, or replaces its caption when it has none. A duration of -1 uses the bubble's own, 0 keeps it until it is cleared.
tips.bubble_icon: The id of a bubble icon: a PNG in the project's textures/bubbles folder (Resources > Textures > Add bubble icon). Pick one from the list.
tips.player_bubble_show: Shows a speech bubble with an icon above the player's name tag to every player in the same dimension. The icon is the project's textures/bubbles/<icon>.png. A duration of 0 keeps it until it is cleared; it also goes when the player logs out or dies. Hidden while the player sneaks or is invisible. The icon blocks show the default bubble (a bubble element with id default replaces it).
tips.player_bubble_show_text: Like show bubble, with a short text (a name, a word) drawn just above the bubble at name-tag size. Animated icons (a strip of square frames with a .png.mcmeta, like block textures) play on every bubble block.
tips.player_bubble_icon: The icon of the bubble above the player; empty without one.
tips.entity_sit_on_block: Sits the entity on the block at x, y, z: on a seatable block (Seat page of a block) its free seat nearest the entity, facing as the seat does; on any other block on the top of its shape. Nothing happens when every seat is taken or the entity already rides something. It stands up when it sneaks, or when the block is broken or replaced.
tips.entity_is_sitting: Whether the entity sits on a seat (a seatable block, or the sit block).
tips.entity_stand_up: Makes the entity stand up when it sits on a seat; it stands where the block's Stand up at rule says.
tips.runtime_image_bubble: Shows the default bubble with an image of a runtime folder as its icon: "folder/name" means config/<modid>/<folder>/<name>.png or .gif on the server (GIFs play). Players get the folder's images when they join and after /<modid> reload; new files appear after a restart or that command. A duration of -1 shows it for 100 ticks, 0 until it is cleared. Nothing shows for an image the server does not have.
tips.radial_open: Opens a radial menu element on the player's screen, as its key does. The server works out which slices the player sees (conditions and set slice) when it opens.
tips.radial_close: Closes the radial menu the player has open, if any.
tips.radial_set_slice: Overrides a slice for this player until set again: shown, hidden or greyed out (it cannot be chosen); default goes back to the slice's condition. Takes effect the next time the menu opens. The tab and slice are their ids.
